title: Shabihe payambar
body:
shabihe payambar akbar zibha ba maidan
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sibte payambar ki laila ki kamayi hai
kya maadar e akbar ne taqdeer ye paayi hai
qaimon may bapa matam qaimon may bapa matam
ay mere jawan akbar zibha ba maidan
shabihe payambar akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo naazon ka paala hai athara baras waala
laila ka dulaara hai athara baras waala
qaimon may bapa matam qaimon may bapa matam
ay mere jawan akbar zibha ba maidan
shabihe payambar akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
socha bhi na tha maa ne ye din kabhi aayega
marne ke liye akbar maidan may jayega
qaimon may bapa matam qaimon may bapa matam
ay mere jawan akbar zibha ba maidan
shabihe payambar akbar...

ye teri khabar sun ke mar jayegi maa akbar
qaimon may bapa matam qaimon may bapa matam
ay mere jawan akbar zibha ba maidan
shabihe payambar akbar...

qaimon may bapa matam qaimon may bapa matam
ay mere jawan akbar zibha ba maidan
shabihe payambar akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir kaun bachayega karti thi buka maadar
cheenenge layeen aa ke jab sar se mere chadar
qaimon may bapa matam qaimon may bapa matam

shabihe payambar akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ne dam e ruqsat jeene ki duayein li
aur kaampte haathon se zainab ne balayein li
qaimon may bapa matam qaimon may bapa matam

<<DIVIDER>>
beta na kisi ka yun mar jaaye jawani may

qaimon may bapa matam qaimon may bapa matam

<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki inayat hai padta hai naqi nauha
